changes.title: Enemy healing potion pickups by dungeon region
changes.text: An identified Potion of Healing now shows enemy-derived potions actually collected in Sewers, Prison, Caves, Dwarven City and Demon Halls. There is no overall total. The original drop region is kept through floor piles and collection, including ordinary enemy loot, Ring of Wealth bonus loot and Lucky enemy drops. Ordinary floor loot and shop potions are not counted.

changes.title: Accurate pickup attribution and safe old-save behavior
changes.text: Healing potion provenance is credited only after successful collection and cannot be counted twice by dropping and collecting the same item. Stacked and split ground piles retain the right region. Counts survive saves and restores; older saves remain explicitly partial instead of inventing missing past pickups. A constructor-reset regression found by the first full test run was repaired; 2056 core methods passed on the corrected source.

changes.title: Intermittent Android Back lag still requires measured device evidence
changes.text: The owner reports occasional delayed edge-gesture window closing. Android Back callbacks, duplicate suppression, event queue and window teardown were inspected, but no reproducible physical-device event timings are available. This candidate does not claim the lag was fixed or alter the existing navigation semantics; existing Back tests stay in place.

changes.title: Full core checks and prior acceptance evidence retained
changes.text: The corrected source passed 2056 methods in 398 suites, zero failures, errors or skips, including the six shared UIMSD run-turn windows. The first failed constructor test run remains recorded rather than hidden. Previously accepted TEST309 retains its private acceptance receipt; this new application requires separate Android device, visual, signing and history verification before acceptance.

changes.text: The immediate predecessor is actual compiled developer TEST309 from producer39862826219 at source a2ef125b28928bf557c3f2bf3ace4e8972330172.
